trials.claim: Tier 1 includes lifetime access to BuzzHooks
trials.claimQuote:
- Get lifetime access to BuzzHooks
- All future Starter (Tier 1), Pro (Tier 2), Agency (Tier 3), Scale (Tier 4) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The terms explicitly reference buying a lifetime tier and state lifetime tiers provide the stated recurring credit allowance, directly supporting lifetime access; the conditions about continued operation do not deny that lifetime tiers exist.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime tiers provide the stated recurring credit allowance for the purchased tier, subject to these Terms and continued operation of the service.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime is not unconditional; it is explicitly subject to Terms and only while the service continues to operate.

exhibits.quote: Features, models, prices, credit costs, processing times, and availability can change. We do not promise uninterrupted access
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to change features and availability and disclaims any promise of uninterrupted access for lifetime buyers.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime tiers provide the stated recurring credit allowance for the purchased tier, subject to these Terms and continued operation of the service.
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms confirm lifetime tiers exist and provide recurring credits as promised.

exhibits.quote: When you create an account, purchase credits, start a subscription, buy a lifetime tier, or use buzzhooks.com in any way, you accept these Terms.
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms explicitly reference buying a lifetime tier, supporting lifetime access claim.

trials.claim: Tier 4 includes 10,000 AI credits per month, 3M Agent tokens, and unlimited BYOK credits
trials.claimQuote:
- 10,000 AI credits per month
- 3M Agent tokens per month
- Unlimited AI Credits/month with BYOK
trials.reasoning: Exhibits support 10,000 credits and suggest unlimited BYOK is reserved for Tier 4, but no exhibit shows the claimed 3M Agent tokens, so the full claim cannot be verified.

exhibits.quote: Monthly subscription credits and lifetime monthly credits refresh on the applicable billing or anniversary cycle and do not carry over unless we say otherwise in the app.
exhibits.argument: Credits are use-it-or-lose-it monthly and do not accumulate, undermining the value of a large monthly allowance.

exhibits.quote: When I bring my own API key, I'm already paying the AI provider directly for generation. Yet BuzzHooks imposes an additional monthly platform credit cap, with unlimited BYOK reserved for Tier 4.
exhibits.argument: BYOK still consumes platform credits with a cap, so unlimited BYOK is tier-gated and not truly unlimited without paying provider costs.

exhibits.quote: 2,600 credits 10,000 credits/month Every month, up to **100 ×** 5-second 480p videos **1,000** images Up to **1080p** video
exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing shows Scale plan includes 10,000 credits per month as claimed for Tier 4.

trials.claim: Tier 1 includes 500 AI credits per month, 100k Agent tokens, and BYOK allowance
trials.claimQuote:
- 500 AI credits per month
- 100k Agent tokens per month
- 2,500 (5x limits) AI Credits/month with BYOK
trials.reasoning: The vendor listing supports a 500-credit Starter amount, but no exhibit verifies the 100k Agent tokens or 2,500 BYOK allowance; reviews about how quickly credits are spent do not prove or disprove the stated amounts.

exhibits.quote: generating a single 15-second real estate commercial using Seedance 2.0 at 1080p costs 1,200 credits. That's almost an entire Tier 2 monthly allowance for one short video.
exhibits.argument: Real-world credit costs show 500 credits yields barely one video, making the advertised allowance commercially unusable.

exhibits.argument: Buyer reports 500 credits produced only two very short videos, contradicting that 500 credits is a meaningful monthly allowance.

exhibits.quote: + $20 extra credits500 credits 1,000 credits/month Every month, up to **10 ×** 5-second 480p videos **100** images
exhibits.argument: Vendor Starter listing shows 500 credits base, supporting Tier 1 credit allowance.

exhibits.quote: generating a single 15-second real estate commercial using Seedance 2.0 at 1080p costs 1,200 credits. That's almost an entire Tier 2 monthly allowance for one short video.
exhibits.argument: A single 15-second video can consume nearly the entire Tier 2 allowance, showing 1,500 credits is insufficient for normal use.

exhibits.quote: I had 1500 credits from tier 2. I generated 3 videos total — one 15 second video with Seedance 2.5, and two 15 second videos with Seedance 2.0. Generating 45 seconds of total video used all 1500 credits
exhibits.argument: Buyer exhausted the full Tier 2 1,500 credit allowance with just 45 seconds of video, demonstrating the limit is extremely low.

exhibits.quote: I had 1500 credits from tier 2. I generated 3 videos total — one 15 second video with Seedance 2.5, and two 15 second videos with Seedance 2.0.

themes.summary: Many buyers say the hooks, presets, and guided workflows make good short-form videos fast.

hits.quote: It works great for creating UGC-style photos, and the video quality is very good.
The models look realistic, and the overall output quality is excellent.
The hooks and presets give you a good starting point, and the Ad Director is especially useful for coming up with the concept and scenes.
I like the templates and video apps, they make it easy to create engaging content.

themes.summary: Several buyers report typos, garbled logos, and interface glitches that force costly regenerations.

hits.quote: 2 of my 3 videos had typos!
some interface glitches when going back to edit the prompt after a video is generated, same when editing scenes text in the cinema studio.
A few small bugs came up during review which the team addressed very fast, including a Google sign in which is already live.

themes.summary: Several Tier 3 buyers say BYOK and bundled models save time versus subscriptions and juggling platforms.

hits.quote: especially since similar tools usually require a monthly subscription for that.
Connecting my own key increases the monthly allowance from 5,000 to 50,000 credits, and I can choose the provider and model that makes sense for the video.
I especially love having access to different AI models and workflows without having to jump between countless different platforms.

themes.summary: Several buyers say support responds quickly, listens to feedback, and ships improvements.

hits.quote: Whenever something doesn’t work as expected, support responds quickly and genuinely tries to help.
I’ve also seen the founder respond to reviews with real answers, which I appreciate.
